plan.notes: Sources (all official, retrieved 2026-09-30): the official BSU 2021-2022 Undergraduate Catalog 'Major in Business Administration (BA/BS)' page for all major course codes, titles, and credits (Miller core 48 cr; Finance 6; Marketing 6; ISOM 6; Management & HR 6; International 3 = 75 cr). UCC (University Core Curriculum) structure per BSU Fall 2025 advising sheets: Foundations, Tier 1, Tier 2, Tier 3 capstone (typically the major capstone; major-restricted). Up to 6 cr of major coursework may count toward the Core. Major 75 cr; UCC beyond major 27 cr (MATH 132 satisfies UCC math; ECON 201 Tier 1 SS; ECON 202 Tier 2 NS/SS; MGT 491 Tier 3); free electives 18 cr; total 120. SEMESTER ARRANGEMENT IS A CONSTRUCTED SAMPLE SEQUENCE - BSU does not publish an official 4-year sequence for this major; an advisor should verify the sequence. Prerequisites are not encoded beyond natural course-numbering order; see the BSU catalog for official prerequisites.
